title: Cloud Fundamentals
description: Reason about cloud cost, migration, and architecture for South African businesses. Tests TCO comparison, lift-and-shift planning, and hybrid cloud design.

seo.overviewBody: Cloud computing allows organizations to deploy scalable infrastructure on demand. Employers look for foundational cloud expertise across AWS and Azure, including virtual networks (VPC/VNet), virtual machines (EC2/Azure VMs), cloud storage, IAM policies, and cost management.

deliverables.title: 1. Cloud Architecture & Network Blueprint
deliverables.desc: Cloud topology diagram detailing VPC subnets, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, and security groups.

deliverables.title: 2. Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) Script
deliverables.desc: Declarative Terraform configuration file provisioning a multi-zone cloud environment with secure IAM roles.

deliverables.title: 3. Cloud Cost Optimization Report
deliverables.desc: Analysis report detailing idle cloud asset removal, right-sizing VM instances, and Reserved Instance cost savings.

faqs.question: What is the Cloud Shared Responsibility Model?
faqs.answer: The cloud provider manages physical security and infrastructure hardware, while the customer is responsible for configuring OS patches, data security, IAM, and firewall rules.

faqs.question: How do you secure Amazon S3 buckets or Azure Storage Blobs?
faqs.answer: Block public access settings, enforce SSE-KMS encryption at rest, and restrict access using IAM bucket policies.

faqs.question: What is the benefit of Infrastructure as Code (IaC)?
faqs.answer: IaC allows infrastructure to be version-controlled in Git, tested automatically, and provisioned repeatably without manual GUI configuration errors.
